en: The image depicts a sepia-toned photograph of a large, elegant building with a symmetrical facade, mansard roof, and ornate decorative elements above the windows. The structure features a prominent clock tower at the corner, and there is a church with a tall steeple in the background, located on what appears to be a hillside. The overall architectural style suggests a late 19th or early 20th-century Central or Eastern European urban setting. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the front of the postcard.
